annotations.title: Plan entering Poland with a business

description: One call for someone from abroad starting a business in Poland: every legal form with available yes/no and the reason for their residence status, yearly taxes and net income to the owner for each available form (dividend tax at the tax-treaty rate of the owner country), setup steps, residence and identity requirements, and the deadline calendar for the best option. Facts carry the act, article, link and verification date.

lump_sum_rate.description: Ryczałt rate for the activity in percent, default 12.

owner_country.description: Tax residence of the owner, ISO2 (e.g. DE, US); omit if Polish resident.

owner_status.description: eu-eea: EU/EEA citizen; swiss: Swiss citizen; third-country-equal: non-EU national with permanent residence, EU long-term residence, a listed temporary residence permit, refugee or temporary protection status, Pole's Card or EU family member; third-country-other: other non-EU national (visa, visa-free, residence permit for running a business); foreign-company-eu-eea / foreign-company-other: a company seated abroad.

vat_payer.description: Will be an active VAT payer (monthly).

year.description: Polish tax year; default the current one.

yearly_costs.description: Expected yearly business costs, PLN net.

yearly_revenue.description: Expected yearly net revenue without VAT, PLN.

name: plan_business_entry
title: Plan entering Poland with a business
